run_evaluate_retrieval: run the evaluate_retrieval function to compute top-k accuracy on a DPR retrieval JSON file
run_simple_tokenizer: run the SimpleTokenizer class to tokenize text into words with character offsets and whitespace
run_tokens_ngrams: run the Tokens ngrams method to extract all n-grams up to length n from tokenized text
run_has_answers: run the has_answers function to check if a context contains any of the given answers
run_tokens_entity_groups: run the Tokens entity_groups method to group consecutive NER-tagged tokens by their entity type
